method: Read all six whole DE/EN goal bodies. Viewed every selected original PNG and each actual browser 360/680 screenshot individually with view_image detail original. No author QC, post-FIRST metadata, prompts or fresh peer judgments read.

wholeGoal.title: Tier- und Pflanzenarten bestimmen
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann unterschiedliche Tier- und Pflanzenarten mithilfe geeigneter Merkmale und Bestimmungshilfen bestimmen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can identify different animal and plant species using suitable traits and identification aids.

checks.actualObservation: Lobed oak leaves with an acorn, a visibly spotted six-legged beetle, two magnifiers and an illustrated guide connect animal and plant identification to observable traits. The leaf margin/lobing and insect colour/pattern remain distinguishable in all three views. No named species is assigned a false taxon.

Guide branches are schematic prompts to compare traits, not a supplied executable dichotomous key. They carry no questions, taxon names or complete routes; the picture must not be counted as a working species-identification exercise. Magnifiers preserve the selected leaf/spot identity.
At 360 the leaf lobes, acorn, beetle spots and guide pages are visible. There is no essential tiny text. At 680 the guide variants and enlarged margins are clear.
No person is shown using a reversed guide or instrument. The open book faces the viewer and the magnifiers are illustration callouts.
Whole unchanged DE/EN goal read; the motif is an orientation cue for that single goal. Whole source duty, assessment and learner achievement remain separate.

Actual PNG 1672×941, close 16:9. Friendly outlined comic illustration, consistent bright palette, no photo or copied worksheet layout, no visible technical ID/watermark/logo. Appropriate concrete orientation for the goal stage; no format exception required.

scopeLimits: No actual taxon determination, executable key or learner performance is evidenced.

wholeGoal.title: Systematikansätze vergleichen und beurteilen
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann historische und aktuelle Ansätze zur Systematisierung von Lebewesen vergleichen und deren Aussagekraft beurteilen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can compare historical and current approaches to classifying organisms and evaluate their explanatory value.

checks.actualObservation: The left wing-based group contains bird and bat. The right rooted tree groups cat with bat, joins bird next and frog below that divergence. For the displayed tetrapod subset this correctly distinguishes a shared flight function from the more recent mammalian common ancestor.

The navy branches are continuous, and each of the four terminal labels has exactly one terminal branch. The tree is a topology; neither branch length nor screen position is asserted as elapsed time. Flügel is a criterion label, not a claim that every historical morphology approach is false.

At 360 both Flügel and Verwandtschaft are clearly readable. All four organisms are separable and the cat/bat sister junction is visible; small taxon labels remain identifiable. At 680 terminal labels and every junction are clear.
No operational human action is depicted. The frontal tree is an external diagram, not a backwards user display.
Whole unchanged DE/EN goal read; the motif is an orientation cue for that single goal. Whole source duty, assessment and learner achievement remain separate.

Actual PNG 1672×940, close 16:9. Friendly outlined comic illustration, consistent bright palette, no photo or copied worksheet layout, no visible technical ID/watermark/logo. Appropriate concrete orientation for the goal stage; no format exception required.

scopeLimits: Illustrates one criterion-versus-phylogeny contrast; does not itself assess the whole historical/current comparison operator.

wholeGoal.title: Modernen Menschen erdgeschichtlich einordnen
wholeGoal.titleEn: Place Modern Humans in Geological History
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den Verlauf der Geschichte des Lebens skizzieren und verdeutlichen, dass der moderne Mensch eine erdgeschichtlich junge Art ist.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can sketch the history of life and show that modern humans are a geologically young species.

checks.actualObservation: A left-to-right schematic time arrow places microbial and fish icons before a dinosaur-era scene and reserves a tiny terminal mark for enlarged modern humans. The explicit Schematische Zeitspur title prevents treating the spacing as calibrated geological durations.

The magnifier enlarges the terminal human interval rather than the whole arrow. Dinosaurs are context along the timeline, not a drawn ancestry branch or a claim of coexistence with modern humans. The figure makes no dates, linear scale, direct fish-to-human ancestry or evolutionary superiority claim.

At 360 the title, microorganisms, fish, dinosaur context and terminal human magnifier remain visible. At 680 the small terminal stripes are visible. The young species message follows from the endpoint callout rather than tiny numbers.
The two people appear only in the terminal magnifier; no reading, measuring or physical inquiry action is claimed.
Whole unchanged DE/EN goal read; the motif is an orientation cue for that single goal. Whole source duty, assessment and learner achievement remain separate.

Actual PNG 1672×941, close 16:9. Friendly outlined comic illustration, consistent bright palette, no photo or copied worksheet layout, no visible technical ID/watermark/logo. Appropriate concrete orientation for the goal stage; no format exception required.

scopeLimits: Schematic temporal overview only; no calibrated date, exact duration ratio or complete history-of-life assessment.

wholeGoal.title: Fossildaten und Datierung
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Fossilfunde, Datierungsmethoden und deren Aussagekraft für Stammbäume bewerten.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can evaluate fossil finds, dating methods, and their significance for family trees.

checks.actualObservation: Two fossil-bearing layers are separated by an orange speckled layer. The magnifier enlarges the ammonite from the lower layer; the person inspects a rock sample matching the orange layer. The clock is a symbolic age cue, and no isotope, measured age or universal radiocarbon applicability is asserted.

The layers are consistent with an undisturbed relative-order example. The sampled layer lies above the ammonite layer: a future explanation must treat that as an age constraint, not automatically assign the sample age to the fossil. The image itself gives no equality or numerical age.
At 360 Alter und Kontext, both fossil locations, the magnifier and the sample/clock relation are visible. At 680 the orange rock texture and separate strata are clear.
The illustrated scientist looks towards the sample held in front of her. No backwards instrument readout or implausible microscope operation is shown; the microscope is background equipment.
Whole unchanged DE/EN goal read; the motif is an orientation cue for that single goal. Whole source duty, assessment and learner achievement remain separate.

Actual PNG 1672×941, close 16:9. Friendly outlined comic illustration, consistent bright palette, no photo or copied worksheet layout, no visible technical ID/watermark/logo. Appropriate concrete orientation for the goal stage; no format exception required.

scopeLimits: No measured absolute age or real learner experiment. A complete dating-method comparison and phylogenetic interpretation remain outside this orientation image.

wholeGoal.title: Genfluss und Migration
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Effekte von Migration und Genfluss auf Populationen beurteilen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can assess the effects of migration and gene flow on populations.

checks.actualObservation: Two populations have different prevailing beetle colours. A blue beetle crosses a directed bridge into the orange-dominated population; a blue/orange pair and offspring are connected by a separate reproduction arrow. This shows that migration coupled to reproduction can contribute inherited variation to another population.

The migration arrow points left to right. The offspring remain two illustrated colour variants, not blended colours. Neither side is falsely depicted as genetically uniform. No alleles, dominance law, quantitative frequency equation or deterministic offspring ratio is labelled. Visible beetle counts must not be treated as a genotype dataset.

At 360 Migration + Fortpflanzung, the bridge arrow, pairing heart, downward offspring arrow and blue/orange differences remain clear. At 680 the offspring variants and receiving population are fully distinguishable.
No person or directional instrument display; the habitat scene is an external schematic.
Whole unchanged DE/EN goal read; the motif is an orientation cue for that single goal. Whole source duty, assessment and learner achievement remain separate.

Actual PNG 1672×941, close 16:9. Friendly outlined comic illustration, consistent bright palette, no photo or copied worksheet layout, no visible technical ID/watermark/logo. Appropriate concrete orientation for the goal stage; no format exception required.

scopeLimits: Qualitative mechanism, not an allele-frequency calculation or proof that every migrating organism reproduces successfully.

wholeGoal.title: Theorien vergleichen
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Darwin/Neodarwinismus mit alternativen Konzepten kontrastieren.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can contrast Darwinism/Neo-Darwinism with alternative concepts.

checks.actualObservation: The acquired-character explanation is framed as Erworben vererbt? and Historische Behauptung. The right panel instead starts with varied giraffes and shows a predominance of long-necked individuals under Selektion. A chromosome callout asks Erblich?; it does not label acquired stretching as inherited DNA change.

Three varied giraffes precede five later schematic individuals under a directional arrow; the changing population size is not a conservation problem or a labelled experiment. The final group retains a shorter individual, avoiding an absolute uniformity claim. No giraffe is drawn changing its own neck under the selection arrow. Chromosome bands are generic icons, not a claimed locus model.

At 360 the acquired-inheritance question, Variation, Selektion and Historische Behauptung remain readable. Giraffe height variation and the selected distribution are visible. Erblich? is smaller but legible in the callout; at 680 all labels and the chromosome icon are clear.
No human manipulation or instrument action depicted; all panels face the viewer.
Whole unchanged DE/EN goal read; the motif is an orientation cue for that single goal. Whole source duty, assessment and learner achievement remain separate.

Actual PNG 1672×941, close 16:9. Friendly outlined comic illustration, consistent bright palette, no photo or copied worksheet layout, no visible technical ID/watermark/logo. Appropriate concrete orientation for the goal stage; no format exception required.

scopeLimits: Supports a historical-acquired-characters versus inherited-variation contrast. Does not independently prove Neo-Darwinist mechanisms, genetics details or every alternative concept.
